archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.1 Identify Innovation Needs and Opportunities
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
Innovation starts with looking outward and forward. In this step, the organization scans for gaps and opportunities: - Are there new data sources we could use? - Are there methods that are outdated? - Are users asking for things we cannot yet deliver? - Are there EU / UNECE developments we must align with?
Sources can be internal (analysts, methodologists, IT architects) or external (Eurostat pilots, UNECE HLG projects, EHDS / dataspace initiatives). This step turns vague ideas into concrete innovation topics.
Value created: A prioritized list of innovation and method-development opportunities.
